data.name: Fozia
data.gender_notes: Fozia is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root word 'afz', meaning 'to protect' or 'to defend'. In Islam, Fozia symbolizes the protection and care of God, as well as the role of parents and community in nurturing and safeguarding their children. The name Fozia carries the meaning “Protector, Defender” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Fozia usually hope their child will grow to embody protector, defender and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Fozia total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
